title: cross-team-engineering-leadership-weekly-staff-notes-2026-03-16
content:
Cross-team engineering leadership weekly staff notes — 2026-03-16

Attendees:
- Ava Martinez (serving-runtime) — facilitator
- Daniel Kim (platform-engineering)
- Priya Nair (observability)
- Liam O'Connor (private-deployments)
- Renee Alvarez (release-engineering)
- + notes from a few async updates submitted to the thread

Agenda:
1) Quick status round-robin (2 min per team)
2) High-priority operational incidents and mitigation updates
3) Cross-team dependencies and rollout schedule for v1.13 runtime release
4) Open blockers and escalation items
5) Action items and owners

1) Round-robin updates:
- Serving-runtime (Ava): Main focus is finalizing the v1.13 performance patches: kernel selection heuristics and KV-cache GC improvements. Nightly load tests passing at 95p latency targets for 2k concurrent connections, but we saw an edge-case with long-tail requests when model sequence length > 8k tokens. Working on a mitigation (short-term: enforce soft max-seq fallback to a compatible variant) and a longer-term plan to optimize attention kernels.
- Platform-engineering (Daniel): Infra provisioning for Dedicated customers: completed the first reserved pool in us-west-2. Autoscaler tuning still in progress — observed oscillation when burst policy is enabled. Daniel opened JIRA-SRV-4821 to track. Expecting configuration freeze by 2026-03-18 for the customer pilot.
- Observability (Priya): Console traces and token-level cost breakdowns dashboard updated. Added new alert when mean KV cache hit ratio drops below 60% for >10 min. Investigating one noisy alert source related to GC churn from serving-runtime.
- Private-deployments (Liam): Private control-plane E2E tests: intermittent failures in deployment reconciliation with KMS-integrated key rotation. Root cause appears to be a race condition in the reconcile loop when external KMS returns 202 for rotation requests. Patch in review at serving-runtime PR #814.
- Release-engineering (Renee): v1.13 release window is still targets next Tue (2026-03-23). Need final sign-off on the rollout playbook; coordinating with SRE to run a canary burn.

2) Operational incidents:
- Incident (2026-03-14): degraded throughput for a subset of customers on dedicated pools in eu-central-1. Cause: autoscaler mis-evaluated GPU capacity due to a metric tagging regression post-migration. Root-cause fix deployed 2026-03-15; retro scheduled. Impact limited via fallback routing policy. Action: Platform to add metric validation gate in the deployment pipeline (owner: Daniel).

3) v1.13 rollout schedule and cross-team dependencies:
- Feature list: kernel selection heuristics, improved KV-cache GC, soft-fallback for long sequences, updated telemetry for cost-per-token breakdown.
- Blockers for release: attention-kernel optimization performance regression in one model family (spotted during nightly). Serving-runtime to open a targeted perf test matrix and coordinate with Research for microbenchmarking (owner: Ava).
- Private deploys: need KMS rotation patch merged and validated before Private customers can opt into v1.13 (owner: Liam).
- Observability: must ship dashboard telemetry changes to prod before rollout to ensure rollback can be measured (owner: Priya).
- Release engineering: finalize canary policy and rollback criteria to include cost-per-token regression threshold and tail-latency bounds (owner: Renee).

4) Open blockers and escalations:
- Long-tail (>8k tokens) regression: short-term mitigation agreed: add a soft-max-seq policy that routes extremely long requests to a compatible variant. Medium-term: implement attention kernel improvements. (Owner: Ava; ETA: short-term 2026-03-18, medium-term 2026-04-06)
- Autoscaler oscillation on burst policy: platform to instrument scaler decision path and add damping. (Owner: Daniel; ETA: 2026-03-20)
- KMS rotation race: serving-runtime patch in PR #814 needs fast review. If not merged by EOD 2026-03-17, schedule an on-call review session. (Owner: Liam + Ava)

5) Action items (explicit owners and dates):
- Ava: Complete perf test matrix for attention kernels and post results to Confluence page CONFL-serve-1067 by 2026-03-18.
- Daniel: Add metric validation gate to infra pipeline and cut a follow-up deploy to staging by 2026-03-20. JIRA: JIRA-SRV-4821.
- Priya: Finish telemetry dashboard push and set up the new KV cache hit ratio alert runbook by 2026-03-19.
- Liam: Drive review and merge of PR #814 (KMS rotation fix); coordinate E2E validation for private control-plane by 2026-03-17.
- Renee: Finalize rollout playbook with SRE and publish canary criteria doc by 2026-03-18.

Other notes / async items:
- Product asked for a short FAQ for customers on how soft-max-seq fallback impacts latency/cost. Dennis (product) will draft; engineering to add recommended migration notes.
- Security: no new findings. Reminder to run monthly dependency-scan ahead of release.

Meeting decisions:
- Proceed with v1.13 canary on 2026-03-23 provided above action items are completed.
- If PR #814 is not merged by 2026-03-17, private-deploy customers will be held from the initial rollout until validated.

Next meeting:
- Weekly staff meeting on 2026-03-23 (same time). Please push status updates to the meeting thread 24 hours in advance.

Notes to self (informal):
- Follow up on noisy GC alert; if we keep seeing churn, consider bumping GC interval or moving to incremental small-step GC to reduce bursts.
- Keep an eye on cost telemetry for canary customers; small regressions compound quickly.

End of notes.
